general.title: General

data.auto_next_player: Next Dart After A Full Turn Starts The Next Player

general.description: While a game is running, the button on the board moves to the next player. The Repeat Hit Window ignores a hit identical to the last one if it arrives this soon after it (0 turns it off). Light The Board On Hits blinks the board's LED ring in the player's colour on every dart, plays award effects and a circular wipe when the turn changes, like the Granboard app.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Pick the speaker, then a sound for each moment, or use Sound Theme folders (/config/www/granboard/sounds/<theme>/<trigger>/*.mp3). Put single files in /config/www/granboard/sounds/ and enter them as /local/granboard/sounds/name.mp3, or use a media-source:// path from Media. Leave a box empty for no sound. One sound plays per dart: an award sound wins over the hit sound, and Any Hit is used when the specific one is empty. Alexa-Compatible Audio is applied automatically when the speaker is an Alexa Media Player: clips are converted (48 kbps, 24 kHz mono MP3, max 240 s) and played over a public HTTPS link. Turn it on to force that for other speakers.

volumes.title: Sound Volumes
volumes.description: Optional volume for each sound, 0-60 %. Empty leaves the speaker's volume alone. Volume is never set above 60 %.

wled.title: WLED Sections
wled.description: Lights placed around the board light up where the dart lands, in the player's colour, and awards and turn changes sweep round them in order. Every light goes back exactly as it was afterwards.

wled_settings.title: WLED Sections Settings

data.wled_only_on: Only Use Lights That Are Already On

wled_settings.description: Hit Flash Length is how long a hit lights the nearest lights before they go back. With Only Use Lights That Are Already On (recommended), lights that are off are never touched; turned off, a light that was off is lit for the effect and then turned back off.

wled_add.title: Add A Light
wled_add.description: Position is where the light sits around the board, seen from the front: Top is the 20, then clockwise. Pick Custom Angle to type degrees (0 = top at the 20, 90 = right at the 6, 180 = bottom at the 3, 270 = left at the 11). Spread is how far either side the light reaches (0 = automatic, shared evenly between your lights).

wled_edit_light.title: Edit {light}
wled_edit_light.description: Position is where the light sits around the board, seen from the front: Top is the 20, then clockwise. Pick Custom Angle to type degrees (0 = top at the 20, 90 = right at the 6, 180 = bottom at the 3, 270 = left at the 11). Spread is how far either side the light reaches (0 = automatic, shared evenly between your lights).

error.already_added: That light is already added. Use Edit A Light to move it.

abort.light_not_found: That light is no longer in the list.
